field.title: Long before Wildora
field.lede: We have been taking groups into these forests for years. With the Heber Au Sable Institute of Environmental Studies at Bishop Heber College, we led field courses for university students from the US and the UK; the institute’s Ecology of Indian Tropics course has run since 1995. These photos are from our courses in 2010 and 2012.
